g.text: Vendor peak figures from the processor table: CPUs in millions of Dhrystone instructions per second (DMIPS / 1 000); AI engines in int8 operations (Myriad 2: fp16),
dense, without sparsity. H100: SXM version (700 W); the variant flown was not disclosed. Versal power: about 130 W when fully used (commercial part). Parts without
published power are omitted from (b). Real applications reach 10-50 % of peak.
